meta.naming: SE = our reimplementation of the DriftNet architecture (no code or weights were released); no number here is DriftNet's reported performance

embedding_drift.definition: per held-out step: 1 - max cosine similarity to any step of the rung's full training set (all categories, before the validation split); summarised over steps of pool-E test trajectories (and over all test trajectories)

R2_paper_comparison_point.population: all R2 (task-disjoint) test trajectories, attacked = positive, threshold 0.5

published_reference_not_ours.source: DriftNet arXiv:2609.10892v1 Table V and VI, task-disjoint test, single run

R2_paper_comparison_point.comparability: not directly comparable (D6 THOUGHT dropped, D1 fourth feature, D7 validation carve-out, 10 seeds vs seed 42, CPU)

reversal.estimator: domain_shift.py M3 (stratified, B = 2000, crc32 population seeds, Holm over 5 folds)

offset_analogue.definition: mean detection logit on held-out pool-E negatives minus mean logit on the fit set's training negatives (all negative categories), per fold and seed; also with training negatives restricted to benign + hard_negative

graded.design: R1 pool E, masks of oov_mechanism.py reused (paired), tool name -> 'unknown_tool' in the step text; mean over 10 seeds x draws; stratified bootstrap B = 2000, rng 20201, conditional on the masks

padding.design: R1 pool E; filler appended to every injection_point observation of attacked trajectories, re-embedded; 10 R1 models scored at test time, no refit; recall at training t_r80; stratified bootstrap B = 2000, rng 20201
